main.description: Per-sample data recorded during an activity, for charts. Its rkey is its activity's. An activity has one per tier that holds any of its channels: each holds time plus the channels and lap and leg fields whose detail category is at its tier, and the activity's own tier also holds the core channels, lengths, sets and lap and leg structure. A record holding any field of a lap or leg also holds its start and elapsed. Where it's stored is who may see it: public streams are a record in the athlete's repo; followers, mutuals or self streams are a record in the athlete's app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for that tier. Never more visible than its activity. The AppView serves it only to the viewers its place allows. Its zones are a separate app.activitytracker.feed.activityZones record, since they can be narrower.

activity.description: The activity's URI; it shares this record's rkey.

channels.description: The channels #streamData holds, so a client knows which charts exist without fetching it.

streamData.description: The data blob's JSON. Every array lines up with time; a channel the activity lacks is absent, and a missing sample is null (blob contents aren't validated against lexicons). No positions: the activity's app.activitytracker.feed.activityTrack holds those.

respirationRate.description: Tenths of a breath per minute.

verticalOscillation.description: Millimeters of vertical bounce per step.

stanceTime.description: Milliseconds of ground contact per step.

verticalRatio.description: Vertical oscillation over step length, in hundredths of a percent.

stanceTimeBalance.description: The left foot's share of ground contact time, in hundredths of a percent.

leftRightBalance.description: Percent of power from the right leg.

ppO2.description: Partial pressure of the oxygen breathed, in millibar.

cns.description: Central nervous system oxygen toxicity, in percent of the limit.

n2Load.description: Nitrogen loading, in percent of the limit.

ndl.description: No-decompression limit in seconds, as the dive computer recorded it (0 while in deco).

decoStopDepth.description: The next decompression stop's depth (the ceiling), in centimeters; null when not in deco.

decoStopTime.description: The next decompression stop's duration, in seconds.

torqueEffectivenessLeft.description: The left leg's torque effectiveness, in hundredths of a percent.

torqueEffectivenessRight.description: The right leg's torque effectiveness, in hundredths of a percent.

pedalSmoothnessLeft.description: The left leg's pedal smoothness, in hundredths of a percent.

pedalSmoothnessRight.description: The right leg's pedal smoothness, in hundredths of a percent.

pcoLeft.description: The left pedal's platform centre offset, in millimeters; negative is inboard.

pcoRight.description: The right pedal's platform centre offset, in millimeters; negative is inboard.

coreTemperature.description: Core body temperature, in hundredths of a degree Celsius.

smO2.description: Muscle oxygen saturation, in tenths of a percent.

totalHemoglobin.description: Total hemoglobin concentration, in hundredths of a gram per deciliter.

ebikeBattery.description: An e-bike's battery level, in percent.

ebikeAssistMode.description: An e-bike's assist mode, as the bike numbers it (0 is off).

ebikeAssistLevel.description: An e-bike's assist level, in percent.

formPower.description: Running form power from a Stryd, in watts.

legSpringStiffness.description: Leg spring stiffness from a Stryd, in hundredths of a kilonewton per meter.

gasSwitches.description: Each switch of breathing gas, in time order. The first gas breathed is a switch at time 0.

diveAlerts.description: Each alert the dive computer raised, in time order.

tankPressures.description: One pressure series per tank, in the order of the activity's dive.tanks.

laps.description: The recording's laps, in order. Absent when its only lap spans the activity. A ski or snowboard activity's laps are its runs and lift rides, a lift as a rest lap.

lengths.description: A pool swim's lengths, in order, rests included.

sets.description: A workout's sets, in order, rests included.

legs.description: A multisport activity's legs, in order, transitions included. Absent when the recording has one sport.

gasSwitch.description: A switch to a breathing gas, named by its oxygen and helium in whole percents (air is 21/0) rather than an index, since the activity's gases may come from another file.

diveAlert.description: An alert the dive computer raised, such as a no-deco limit reached or a fast ascent.

kind.description: What the alert was: FIT's dive_alert names in lower camel case, plus UDDF alarms FIT has no name for. A kind the file names but these don't is kept as the file names it.

tankPressure.description: One tank's pressure over the dive.

pressure.description: Millibar, lined up with time; null where the tank has no reading.

lap.description: A lap as the recording device split it.

length.description: One length of a pool swim.

rest.description: True for an idle length (a rest at the wall).

set.description: One set of a strength, HIIT or cardio workout, or a rest between sets. Category and exercise are the FIT profile's tokens in snake case (bench_press, single_arm_cable_row).

rest.description: True for a rest between sets.

category.description: Exercise category, such as bench_press or squat.

leg.description: One leg of a multisport activity, or a transition between legs. The #lap fields plus its sport.

sport.description: The leg's activity type, an app.activitytracker.feed.activity sport token; multisport for a transition.

transition.description: True for a transition between legs.

gearChange.description: A shift by electronic shifting, with the gears it shifted to as the derailleurs number them (rear gear 1 is the largest cog).
